roundContent.accountsContract: A throwaway test copied the overlap test's shape. It asked testnats.URL in the parent and then in subtests 'widen' and 'narrow'. The parent got account t1, widen t2 (and t2 again on a second call), narrow t3. Narrow saw 0 streams on entry even though widen had just created one. So each subtest has an account of its own, and the delete-then-create in narrow runs against an account with nothing in it. In this pod, without -race, TestEnsureStreamWithConfigStartsWhenADeployedSubjectOverlapsItsOwn passes 30/30 and TestRewatchOntoARecreatedBucketRefillsTheCache passes 30/30. That says nothing about the -race configuration, which this pod cannot run (no C compiler, dispatch://INFRA-257).
roundContent.sweep: Pattern set 1, the server's answer: 'error creating store|creating store for stream|streamStoreFailed|streamCreateErrorCode' matches only internal/testnats (the retry and its own tests). Pattern set 2, the call shape: every test file with a DeleteStream/DeleteKeyValue (cmd/listener/main_test.go, internal/bus/kv_key_test.go, stream_config_test.go, internal/cistore/burst_test.go, internal/kvwatch/end_test.go, kvwatch_test.go, repair_test.go, internal/store/interest_markers_test.go, kv_test.go), with every create, add, ensure, open or recreate that follows in the same test. Every recreate of a deleted name goes through testnats.RecreateKeyValue, except the overlap test, where the delete now runs in a fresh account. The remaining hits are deletes with no recreate of that name in that test: cmd/listener main_test.go:4565 ends the interest watcher and its store.Open belongs to the next test; kv_test.go:2041 deletes the role bucket and its CreateKeyValue at 2069 is a different test; burst_test.go:940, end_test.go:227 and repair_test.go:186/221/264 delete without recreating; kv_key_test.go deletes only in t.Cleanup. Only internal/testnats/nats.go calls Delete outside a test file. There is no third site.
roundContent.startGateLock: TestEveryGatePortLiesJustBelowThisMachinesEphemeralRange fails when StartGate takes a fixed 20000-20999 band: 'a gate took port 20220, want one of the 1000 ports below 16000, the first port of this machine's ephemeral range (/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range holds "16000 65535\n")'. Limit: a StartGate that ignores the file and always uses the fallback (gatePorts("")) passes it in this pod, because gVisor's low bound, 16000, equals fallbackEphemeralLow. It fails only on a machine whose range starts elsewhere, such as CI's Ubuntu (32768). With no injection seam, by the architect's ruling, CI is where that mutation is caught.
roundContent.bandTable: Each break fails the table: expected gVisor band 15500 ('want 1000 from 15500'); code band at low-500 ('15500-16499, which reaches the range starting at 16000'); floor check removed ('want a refusal'); refusal message no longer naming the low bound ('does not name the range's first port, 1024'). Restored, internal/testnats passes whole (ok 9.9 s).
